title: A normalized coefficient comparison preserves the augmented Koszul fiber
statement: For X,d,e as in def-wf-tensor-unit-square-data, p in A, and any natural isomorphism k of completed constants with their e-pullback satisfying NormalizedConstants, take arbitrary complexes U,V. There exist product and fiber isomorphisms delta,b satisfying NormalizedFiber for the prescribed beta(k), and H(unit(Tot(U tensor V))) followed by b equals alpha followed by unit(Tot(HU tensor HV)), as an equality of actual chain maps. Neither flatness nor passage to the derived category is part of this statement.

proof.text: Naturality of k identifies the Koszul transitions and its generator normalization fixes the degree-zero inclusion.
The pure-tensor pullback formula and tensor-unitor equation identify the level units on each totalization inclusion.

Automorphism pullback preserves the countable products. Construct delta from the canonical product comparison and beta; use projections to prove its one-minus-shift square and its augmentation equation.

Apply the functorial shifted-cone comparison to the commuting differential square. It uses delta on both coordinates, carries the actual (u,0) unit to the target unit, and gives both NormalizedFiber coordinate equations.

theorem normalizedKoszulFiber_unit_transport (p : A)
    (k : constants X d ⋙ transport X d e ≅ constants X d)
    (hk : NormalizedConstants X d e k)
    (U V : CochainComplex (adicDatumModules X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d)) ℤ) :
    ∃ (delta : (complexes X d e).obj (product X d p (tensor X d U V)) ≅
        product X d p (tensor X d ((complexes X d e).obj U)
          ((complexes X d e).obj V)))
      (b : (complexes X d e).obj (fiber X d p (tensor X d U V)) ≅
        fiber X d p (tensor X d ((complexes X d e).obj U)
          ((complexes X d e).obj V))),
      NormalizedFiber X d e p k U V delta b ∧
      (complexes X d e).map (unit X d p (tensor X d U V)) ≫ b.hom =
        (alpha X d e U V).hom ≫ unit X d p
          (tensor X d ((complexes X d e).obj U) ((complexes X d e).obj V))
